blueprint_subsections_note: Recorded as BLUEPRINT.md Section 141 subsections, not a new top-level section, so that the pinned latest_locked_section=141 in tests/resume_reference_style_lock_v1_test.py and the live src/career_os_state.py max-heading validator both stay consistent -- the same reason §141.6 and §141.10 give.

santander.description: A Santander resume/cover-letter package was produced before the exact current first-party requisition had been re-opened and proven actionable in the operating session doing the package work. Prior/cached/discovery-level verification was treated as sufficient at package time, reproducing the same class of failure BLUEPRINT.md Section 135 already locked for pursuit-time actionability, but at the later package-generation stage.

draftkings.description: A DraftKings resume drifted from the canonical Bora gold-quality presentation family (BLUEPRINT.md Section 141 / 141.10, docs/resume/BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1.json) by being reconstructed from doctrine text rather than spawned from the exact approved gold DOCX artifact, and leaked internal Career OS/governance/implementation-control language into candidate-facing text.

reproduced_failures.scope_note: All reproduced failures are recorded as operating-discipline failures for this package/live-actionability gate. None of the roles' substantive job content or resume content becomes universal Candidate Truth, a new schema field, or a new persisted enum.

point32health.description: Point32Health Business Analyst R9102 returned HTTP 200 and retained the requisition token in source-level retrieval while the exact browser-rendered role page was a dead error state (The page you are looking for does not exist). A package was incorrectly allowed to proceed because transport/requisition-token evidence was treated as sufficient after the package-time probe returned `TITLE_MATCH=False`, despite the surviving requisition token.

package_time_actionability_recheck.extends_not_replaces: BLUEPRINT.md Section 135 (LIVE_ROLE_VERIFIED_ACTIONABILITY_GATE_V1) and AGENTS.md's Fresh First-Party Employer Source Rule -- this record sharpens the timing of an already-locked gate to also cover package time; it does not create a competing actionability system.
package_time_actionability_recheck.description: Immediately before Claude drafting, DOCX mutation, cover-letter drafting, or any other meaningful package work for a role, the exact current first-party employer requisition must be re-opened in the current operating session. The recheck must positively establish matching role/title identity, matching requisition identity, substantive current job-description content, and a current actionable application route/instruction. HTTP 200, a surviving requisition token/string, an ATS shell, or an Apply-like control alone never establishes actionability. Any explicit dead/error-page state fails closed even when HTTP 200 is returned or the requisition token survives. A prior pursuit-time pass of the Section 135 gate does not by itself satisfy this package-time recheck.
trigger_points: immediately before Claude drafting candidate-facing wording
immediately before any DOCX mutation of a resume derivative
immediately before any other meaningful candidate-facing package work for that role

conditions: an HTTP-200 response whose rendered/current page is an explicit dead/error state
a missing positive role/title identity match even when the requisition token is present
a blank or contentless requisition shell
a JavaScript-only page with no recoverable current job-description content
a generic careers/search redirect with no matching current role
an expired or closed posting page
an identity mismatch between the requisition opened and the requisition the package is for
a missing current application route or instructions

rescue_prohibition.description: None of the listed sources, alone or combined, may substitute for the current first-party re-open when the package-time recheck fails -- consistent with BLUEPRINT.md Section 135's existing rule that discovery/index evidence may never by itself establish VERIFIED_LIVE or authorize meaningful tailoring/package/application work.

package_gate_disqualifying_conditions.semantic_quorum: PASS requires all four positive signals together: matching role/title identity; matching requisition identity; substantive current JD content; current actionable application route/instruction. Any explicit dead/error marker is a veto. HTTP status and raw-token presence are transport/source clues only, never sufficient actionability evidence.

package_gate_failure_handling.description: When the package-time actionability recheck fails, no resume, cover letter, or other candidate-facing package may be generated or revised for that role. Preserve historical analysis if useful. Report the current role as non-actionable/verification-required using the existing, independent role_status and source_verification_status axes already defined in schemas/job.schema.json (Blueprint Sections 19-21/135) -- for example role_status=POSSIBLY_STALE or UNCLEAR, and/or source_verification_status=SOURCE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or DIRECT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE -- never a new persisted job/actionability enum. Do not collapse the two axes or infer one from the other. A later closed/stale posting does not erase historical Employer Truth, historical qualification analysis, or Submitted Application Truth already captured for that role; only current package-time actionability changes.

gold_artifact_spawn_gate.extends_not_replaces: BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.10 / docs/resume/BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1.json, which remains the gold-quality presentation/quality acceptance reference of record.
gold_artifact_spawn_gate.description: Resume spawning must use the exact current Bora gold-quality DOCX artifact (Bora_Chaush_Cable_One_Claude_First_G_Adjudicated.docx) as the starting document when that artifact is available. Its SHA-256 must be verified against the canonical gold-reference record (docs/resume/BORA_GOLD_QUALITY_REFERENCE_V1.json source_artifact.sha256, ec3a9f9c6e2fc429e01892f61a074a71319ec6586566b6c1cf60808eba2f3f70) before cloning and making bounded content edits.
gold_artifact_spawn_gate.reconstruction_prohibition: A chat or agent must not reconstruct the gold family from scratch with a fresh document/template, ad-hoc tables, margins, typography, or section grammar merely by reading doctrine -- this is exactly how the DraftKings drift reproduced.

stop_condition.when: the exact gold artifact is unavailable, or its hash does not match the canonical gold-reference record
stop_condition.action: stop rather than improvising a new resume template

internal_jargon_translation_requirement.extends_not_replaces: BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.11's human_naturalness QA dimension and .cursor/rules/resume.mdc's Candidate-Facing Style section -- this record sharpens both with the exact leaked-term pattern the DraftKings failure reproduced.
internal_jargon_translation_requirement.description: Candidate-facing package text must not expose internal Career OS/governance/evidence-system/implementation-control language unless the exact term is independently job-relevant and recruiter-natural. Otherwise translate the supported work into ordinary professional American English.

pre_delivery_package_qa_reject_condition.extends_not_replaces: BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.11's seven-dimension final-package QA checklist -- this record makes the structural drift patterns explicit reject conditions rather than leaving them implicit in 'reference conformance'.
conditions: a PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading (or equivalent generic heading)
pre_delivery_package_qa_reject_condition.exception: unless an explicit employer format instruction requires a documented exception

operating_chain_consistency.description: AGENTS.md, BLUEPRINT.md, .cursor/rules/resume.mdc, and this machine-readable gate record express one consistent operating chain, so a fresh chat recovering the repository receives the same fail-closed package-time actionability recheck and gold-artifact-based spawning rules regardless of which surface it reads first.

unchanged_doctrine: BLUEPRINT.md Section 135's live-role verified actionability gate, now explicitly requiring the positive semantic quorum (matching role/title identity, matching requisition identity, substantive current JD content, and current actionable route/instructions) with HTTP-200/token-only insufficiency and explicit dead/error-page veto
BLUEPRINT.md Section 140's DOCX-first default, requirement/JD-to-evidence crosswalk, real-hyperlink-object rule, and rendered-artifact QA authority
BLUEPRINT.md Section 141's presentation grammar and Section 141.7's research-backed writing constraints
BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.10-141.11's gold-quality acceptance reference and final-package QA-dimension checklist
schemas/job.schema.json's existing role_status and source_verification_status enums, unmodified and uncollapsed
Candidate Truth, Match Truth, and qualification/pursuit runtime logic

must_never: generate or revise a resume, cover letter, or other candidate-facing package for a role that fails the package-time actionability recheck
spawn a resume derivative from a freshly reconstructed template instead of the exact hash-verified gold artifact when that artifact is available
leave internal Career OS/governance/evidence-system/implementation-control language in candidate-facing text absent genuine job relevance
invent a new persisted job/actionability enum instead of using the existing role_status/source_verification_status axes
treat a discovery index, aggregator, cached snippet, prior capture, chat summary, or memory as sufficient to rescue a failed package-time recheck
deliver a package to Bora with an unaddressed reject condition from pre_delivery_package_qa_reject_conditions absent a documented employer exception
role_tailoring_boundary.gold_reference_authority_scope: This record is a package-time operating gate only. It is never a source of Candidate Truth: substantive factual content must still trace only to approved Candidate Truth / claim-evidence lineage, exactly as before this lock.

non_goals.reference: BLUEPRINT.md Section 133 build-economy gate; Section 134 Non-Goals; Section 141.5/141.9/141.12 Doctrine-only locks
excludes: an automated grammar/style/ATS-score validator or linter beyond this doctrine record and its accompanying regression test
any change to Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/pursuit logic, immigration logic, or schemas
any change to the protected resume master or resume patch/lineage architecture in .cursor/rules/resume.mdc
an autonomous or unsupervised package-generation runtime -- the recheck and spawn gate locked here remain human-operated operating discipline, not a validator implementation
